title: This Video Game Has the Grossest First Kiss Scene Ever — and It’s on Purpose
summary: Have you ever had a moment in a video game that made you go “Eww!”? The new game Mixtape has a scene that’s so gross, even the people who made it felt icky. The game is about a girl named Stacey who remembers her high school days through songs. At one point, she thinks about her first kiss with a boy named Colin. And here’s the wild part: you get to control both of their tongues! The game normally looks like a cool animated movie, but during this flashback, it switches to a super-detailed, slimy style. You see every gross detail — strings of spit, awkward movements, and hear all the slurpy sounds. It’s meant to feel exactly like a real first kiss: clumsy, too long, and kind of disgusting. The creative director, Johnny Galvatron, said the team wanted players to feel embarrassed and grossed out, just like a real teenager. They even used a special particle system to make the saliva ropes look realistic. One developer, Roman, had to replace the mouth sounds with bird chirps while working on it because he couldn’t stand listening to it for hours. Don’t worry, though — you only have to play this scene once. The game is split into songs, and each one has a different mini-game. So after you survive the horrible kiss, you can move on to less slobbery adventures. Mixtape is a coming-of-age story full of music, humor, and yes, a little bit of ick.
why_it_matters: It shows that growing up isn’t always smooth or cool, and video games can turn those awkward moments into something you can laugh about later.

background_read: Some video games use awkward or gross moments on purpose to make players feel real emotions, like embarrassment, that a character is feeling. This helps you understand the character better.
In real life, a first kiss is often clumsy and full of mixed feelings, so Mixtape tries to capture that messy experience instead of making it look perfect like in a romantic movie.
Johnny Galvatron (the creative director who leads the game’s story and style) wanted the scene to be so realistic that even the developers had a hard time working on it without laughing or cringing.
Article_Structure: WHO: Stacey, a girl remembering her high school days, and her first kiss partner Colin
WHAT: A disgusting and awkward first-kiss flashback that players control, complete with slurpy sounds and spit strings
WHERE: Inside the video game Mixtape, which is split into musical levels
WHY: To make players feel exactly how embarrassing and gross a real teenage first kiss can be

perspectives.description: Some players will feel the scene is brave and true to life, making them laugh and remember their own clumsy first-kiss moments.
Other players might find the slimy details too disgusting and wish they could skip the scene entirely, even though it only happens once.
The gross kiss is not a random gross-out joke; it is a small mini-game inside a bigger coming-of-age story that uses different styles to match each song’s mood.
